plugin.name: Command Editor
plugin.description: Edit the command at the prompt in a real editor window, then put it back or run it.

editor.title: Edit command
editor.multilineHint: Multi-line text goes in as one paste. Shells without bracketed paste (bash before 5.1) run each line as it arrives.
editor.multilineRuns: This shell has no bracketed paste, so each line runs as soon as it is inserted.
editor.fullScreen: A full-screen program is open. Close it to edit the command line.

defaultHotkey.label: Open with Ctrl+Shift+X
defaultHotkey.description: Turn off to use only a key you bind in Keybindings.

clearMode.label: Replace the line with
clearMode.description: The keys that clear the prompt before the edited command goes in.
clearMode.readline: Ctrl+E, Ctrl+U (bash, zsh, fish, most shells)
